_how: value_opts: options whose help shows a separate value placeholder; derived by tests/fixtures/forbid_runner_options_derive.py from each tool's --help capture (jest: yargs type tags; mocha: lib/cli/run-option-metadata.cjs; rails test: Rails::TestUnit::Runner + minitest's OptionParser summary).

pnpm binary fallback._how: each command run through real bash with the real pnpm in a two-package workspace whose root, packages/a and a directory named vitest each carry an argv-printing node_modules/.bin/vitest; `ran` is every (cwd, argv) a stub received. Regenerate: tests/test_forbidden_pm_flags.py::_pnpm_fallback_ws/_pnpm_ran.

whole-suite runner head._how: Round-4 review M4. Each row ran through real bash with the real runner (go 1.25.3, pytest, uv, vitest 5.0.5, jest 30.5.2, mocha 12.0.3, rspec 3.13, cargo 1.99) in a project whose test files append a marker when loaded; `whole` is true when every file of the project loaded (go: packages a, b and the root package r; cargo: the lib's unit tests l and integration tests a, b). `forbid` is the whole_suite entry, test roots per project (go none, pytest/vitest/jest tests, mocha test, rspec spec, cargo tests). The matcher must refuse exactly the whole runs.

r4 reviewer matcher rows._how: The round-4 execution review's 83 matcher rows (proofs4/match_probe.py): (forbidden whole_suite command, test roots, command, expected). The reviewer expected `vitest run --silent src/a.test.ts` allowed and `vitest run --project unit` refused; vitest's `--silent [value]` takes the file as its value, so the first is a whole-suite run and is refused (the review agrees). `--project` is decided in DESIGN §9 (L3).

selectors and proxies._how: Round-4 review L2/L3. Run through real bash with the real runners (vitest 5.0.5, jest 30.5.2, mocha 12.0.3, rspec 3.13, cargo 1.99, pytest), the real npx/npm 11 and Debian's xvfb-run, in projects whose test files append a marker when loaded: vitestproj/jestproj have projects unit (a, b) and e2e (c); cargows is a two-crate workspace (p1: a, p2: b); cargo's single crate has lib unit tests (l) and integration tests (a, b). `whole` is true when every file loaded. `forbid` is the whole_suite entry; test roots: tests (vitest*, jest*, cargo), test (mocha), spec (rspec), none (cargows).

env wrappers._how: Round-5 review M2. Each command ran through real bash with the real cross-env 10.1, dotenv-cli 11.1 and env-cmd 11.0 (npm), in a directory whose .env sets NODE_ENV=fromfile, .env.production NODE_ENV=production and .env-cmdrc.json {"dev":{"NODE_ENV":"dev"}}, against a `vitest` stub printing its argv and NODE_ENV/TZ/CI. `ran` is null when the stub never ran, else its args after `vitest` and the variables it saw set.

rows.cmd: pnpm exec cross-env CI=1 vitest run
npx --yes cross-env@10 CI=1 vitest run src/a.test.ts

multi-run bodies._how: Round-5 review L1. Real vitest 5.0.5 under real pnpm 11.21 through real bash, in a project with three vitest projects (unit: a b, e2e: c, slow: d) whose test files append a marker when loaded. `body` is the `test` script a whole-suite `pnpm test` forbid resolves; `body_ran` and `ran` are the markers `pnpm test` and `cmd` loaded. A command that loads everything the body did should be refused.
